Add ONLY these accessories: A large black leather soft duffel with short handles and broad shoulder strap.. Use each accessory once. Preserve all other cuts, colors, proportions and fabric detail. Empty hollow clothes, no skin or mannequin, white seamless background, full outfit uncropped. Do not add anything.
